name: Stage 46:1: Skavsta flygplats to Släbro, etapp 46
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 46:1, Skavsta flygplats to Släbro, etapp 46.
utilities: Skavsta terminal has toilets, bus/coach access, Pressbyrån/light food, and other commercial airport services; terminal hours and customer access apply.
Airport terminal curb/road access is controlled: use signed airport parking/drop-off or the official F11/Moder Jord stage parking, not roadside stopping in the airport area.
F11/Moder Jord has official 24h free parking by the museum/viewpoint area; distinguish this from paid airport parking.
The Oppeby/Släbro end has local bus access and ICA Supermarket Knuten about 1 km away for reliable resupply.
waterSources: No confirmed public drinking-water tap, shelter, fireplace, or formal campsite was found on this 5.5 km access connector.
Skavsta has toilets and food/drink sales, but no official drinking fountain/refill point was confirmed. Treat airport water as customer/paid-service access unless verified on site.
Use Skavsta terminal/commercial services before starting, ICA Knuten after the end, or continue onto stage 46 to the official year-round Bergsstugan tap.
Nyköpingsån is scenery, not a verified potable source; treat/boil any natural water and prefer carried water here.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Access connector from Skavsta/F11 to the Oppeby/Släbro junction with stage 46. Official distance is 5.5 km; local drawn geometry is about 5.1 km and matches the official endpoints closely. Naturkartan embedded text around 4.2 km and older community tables around 4.0 km appear to be stale distance noise rather than a different route.

Topology: model 46:1 as an optional airport access branch into the shared Oppeby/Släbro hub, not as the main continuation after stage 45. OSM relation 6575251 draws continuously; its end shares the same hub as stages 45 and 46 around 58.770413,16.974096. Use official 58.783767,16.925350 for displayed start metadata, while OSM routable geometry begins about 17 m away.

Expect easy but exposed walking: airport/service-road context, open farmland, asphalt/roadside sections, then the south bank of Nyköpingsån. D 627/Skavstarondellen sections can feel traffic-heavy and have limited shoulder.

User reports describe the Skavsta-road part as more practical connector than destination hike, with Moder Jord/F11 and the Nyköpingsån/Släbro heritage area as the rewarding parts. After rain or in high summer, expect wet grass and nettles along the river path.

The Släbro end is culturally sensitive, with runestones, rock carvings, grave-field/old crossing context, and bridge remains. Stay on paths and do not step on or touch carving surfaces; do not chalk, paint, rub, clean, scratch, climb on, move, dig around, or otherwise alter ancient remains.

No current official fault report, route closure, or municipal Skavsta/F11/Oppeby/Släbro traffic notice affecting the route was found on 2026-04-27. Long-term Skavsta/Ostlänken rail and station works are a dynamic access watch item, not a current route closure.

facilities.name: Skavsta flygplats / stage 46:1 start
facilities.description: Official access-stage start near Skavsta/F11. Connects eastward toward Oppeby/Släbro and stage 46.

facilities.name: Skavsta terminal services/toilets
facilities.description: Airport terminal toilets are listed in check-in, departure, baggage reclaim, and indoor parking areas. Food/drink are commercial terminal services; no official drinking-water refill point was confirmed. Hours and access vary, and overnight terminal stays are not allowed.

facilities.name: Skavsta flygplats bus stop
facilities.description: Bus access for Nyköping/Skavsta, including Sörmlandstrafiken line 515 to Nyköping center/station and airport-coach options. Verify live departures and ticketing.

facilities.name: Skavsta terminal paid parking
facilities.description: Official airport parking for terminal access. Short-term/drop-off has limited free time and then paid parking; use signed areas only.

facilities.name: No stopping on Skavsta airport roads
facilities.description: Skavsta forbids stopping and parking along roads in the airport area. Use signed terminal parking/drop-off or the official F11/Moder Jord trail parking.

facilities.name: Verkstadsskolan coach stop
facilities.description: Nearby coach/bus stop context by the airport area, including Flixbus/airport-area access in current airport guidance. Verify operator and live departures before relying on it.

facilities.name: Aiden / former Connect Hotel Skavsta
facilities.description: Hotel/service point near the terminal. Some older sources call it Connect Hotel Skavsta; useful because Skavsta terminal overnight stays are not allowed. Customer access applies.

facilities.name: Pressbyrån Skavsta
facilities.description: Terminal snacks/light meals/coffee and transport-ticket context. Treat as a commercial service with airport opening hours.

facilities.name: F11 Museum
facilities.description: Swedish aerial reconnaissance museum in the former F11 military airfield area; opening hours are limited and seasonal, so verify before planning a visit.

facilities.name: Moder Jord / Blåbärskullen
facilities.description: Anita Grede wood sculpture/viewpoint over the Skavsta/F11 runway landscape.

facilities.name: F11/Moder Jord 24h free parking
facilities.description: Official 24h free parking context at the F11/Moder Jord area. This is separate from paid airport parking; verify local signs.

facilities.name: Blåbärskullen picnic table
facilities.description: Mapped picnic table/rest stop near the F11/Moder Jord viewpoint.

facilities.name: Skavstarondellen road-walk warning
facilities.description: Open road/asphalt/traffic exposure near Skavstarondellen and D 627. Walk visibly and expect limited shoulder in parts.

facilities.name: Tåå bus access
facilities.description: Rural/access stop near the road-walk portion west of Nyköpingsån. Verify live service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Minningevägen bus access
facilities.description: Mid-route bus access context near the airport-road/farmland section. Verify live departures and safe walking approach.

facilities.name: Bönsta bus access
facilities.description: Bus stop north of the route corridor. Useful for access planning only if live service and walking approach fit the trip.

facilities.name: Stage 46:1 distance-source caveat
facilities.description: Official distance is 5.5 km and local/OSM geometry is about 5.1-5.3 km. Naturkartan embedded 4.2 km text and older 4.0 km community listings look stale; do not treat them as a separate route.

facilities.name: Nyköpingsån south-bank path
facilities.description: Route turns from road/open landscape toward the south bank of Nyköpingsån. Wet grass and nettles can be an issue after rain or in high summer.

facilities.name: Släbro runestones and fika stop
facilities.description: Official stage-steward tip: benches/tables by the runestones, with old crossing/bridge context nearby. Keep to paths around heritage surfaces.

facilities.name: Sö 45 runestone
facilities.description: Runestone marker in the Släbro heritage area near the stage endpoint.

facilities.name: Sö 367 runestone
facilities.description: Companion Släbro runestone beside the stage endpoint and picnic area.

facilities.name: Släbro runestone picnic table
facilities.description: Picnic table/bench spot matching the official stage-steward fika tip at the Släbro runestones.

facilities.name: Släbro old crossing/bridge remains
facilities.description: Old river-crossing/bridge-remains context below the runestones; visible details can depend on water level. Keep to durable paths.

facilities.name: Släbro rock carvings / Släbroparken
facilities.description: Broader Släbro heritage landscape with hundreds of rock-carving marks, grave-field and hollow-way context. Sensitive site: do not walk on or touch carved surfaces.

facilities.name: Släbro heritage protection warning
facilities.description: Protected ancient remains: no camping or fires here, and do not touch, chalk, paint, rub, clean, scratch, climb on, move, dig around, metal-detect, or otherwise alter runestones, carvings, rocks, or burial features. Keep to durable paths and signed areas.

facilities.name: Oppeby / stage 46 connection

facilities.name: Nyköpingsån foot/cycle bridge
facilities.description: Practical bridge/crossing into Oppeby and the Stage 46 start area.

facilities.name: Släbro local parking
facilities.description: Mapped local parking near Släbro, reported with one-day maxstay in OSM. Not treated as official trail parking; verify signs.

facilities.name: Skavsta future station/rail works watch
facilities.description: Long-term Skavsta rail/station development is planned, with station completion stated around 2034 in municipal material, but no current route closure was found on 2026-04-27.

facilities.name: Stage 46:1 camping restriction
facilities.description: Nyköping public-place camping rules are restrictive, and this connector crosses airport, road, farmland and heritage contexts. Do not camp at Skavsta, Släbro, public parks/places, road verges, fields or heritage surfaces.

facilities.name: Dog control on Stage 46:1
facilities.description: From 1 March to 20 August dogs must be under strict control where wildlife may be present; Nyköping also requires leash in several public-place contexts. Keep dogs close around roads, heritage sites and Oppeby parks.

facilities.name: Stage 46:1 fire-risk check
facilities.description: No fireplace is confirmed on this connector, and fires should not be made at Släbro heritage surfaces. No formal fire ban was found on 2026-04-27, but fire bans/fire risk change quickly; check Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens before any fire use elsewhere.
